subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the population of two states A and B in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7788ddbd38ba35464792a78a5f26f2f8cbc68468cfdbcf0145894de7ed3b365.png] 

What is the difference between the average population of A and B in all the years?
solution: **Calculation:** Average population of A = (500 + 700 + 550 + 400 + 300)/5 ⇒ 2450/5 = 490 Average population of B = (800 + 600 + 450 + 350 + 500)/5 ⇒ 2700/5 = 540 Difference between the average population of A and B in all the years = 540 - 490 = 50
